messages.subject: International Statistical Ecology Conference, 6-9 July 2010,
parts:
Announcement of second International Statistical Ecology Conference

University of Kent at Canterbury 6-9 July 2010

After the successful first International Statistical Ecology Conference held last year, we want to inform you of the conference upcoming in 2010.

We are pleased to list our group of invited speakers:
- Professor Lord Robert May
- Carmen Fernandez
- Jeff Laake
- Darryl MacKenzie
- Marc Mangel
- Ken Pollock
- Nigel Yoccoz

Please place these dates into your diary, and revisit the conference website regularly http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/isec2010/ for further details regarding abstract submission, registration, and workshop information. Share this information with your colleagues, and apologies in advance if you should receive this email because of your membership on more than one list-server.


--
Eric Rexstad
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews
St. Andrews Scotland KY16 9LZ
